_doc: Hook/caption templates for TemplateProvider. Keys are trigger kinds (Roblox event kinds or clip-detector reasons). Placeholders: {game} {genre} {detail} {cta}. A template may only mention an event its key proves happened (guardrails re-check this). No engagement bait, no emoji in hooks/on_screen (DejaVu font).

boss_defeat: The boss fight in {game} gets intense
How this boss went down in {game}
This {game} boss did not last long
Boss down. {game} does not play around
Watch the final hit on this boss
victory: Made it to the end in {game}
The moment it all paid off
rare_item: Did not expect this drop in {game}
This item in {game} is hard to get
high_score: How far can you push the score in {game}?
death: That was one jump too far
unexpected: That was not supposed to happen
This moment in {game} came out of nowhere
loud_audio: Turn the sound up for this one
scene_changes: So much happens in a few seconds of {game}

obby: This obby in {game} tests your timing

victory: Made it to the end of {game}. {cta}
death: So close in {game}. Think you can do better? {cta}

rationale.boss_defeat: boss defeat logged by the in-game event logger - clear payoff moment
rationale.victory: victory/finish logged by the event logger - satisfying resolution
rationale.rare_item: rare item event logged - novelty and reward
rationale.high_score: leaderstats high score change logged - visible progress
rationale.death: player death logged - tension and near-miss drama
rationale.loud_audio: audio loudness spike detected - energy in the clip
rationale.motion_peak: high on-screen motion detected - fast action
rationale.scene_changes: several scene changes detected - visual variety
rationale.generic: no strong trigger - relies on game identity
